caption: The drawing depicts a single, round-bodied ceramic jug with a narrow neck, a protruding spout, and a curved handle attached at the top of the body and the midsection near the rim. The jug is reddish-brown in color with darker brown, almost black, speckled bands encircling the widest part of the body and the lower section, as well as horizontal ribbing visible throughout its surface. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or patterns present. In the lower right corner, there is a small green signature and date: "E.H. Shacklady 1934."
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
